A power of attorney ends when the person who signed it dies, so that route won't work for your father's car, and the help center points to a separate article, "Selling a car you inherited," which isn't available to me here. That means I can't tell you which documents you'll need to sell a car still in your father's name, so please contact a store for that part. In general, selling to Northwind starts with an instant offer online using the VIN or license plate, followed by an appraisal appointment, a roughly 30-minute inspection, and then signing the paperwork and getting paid.
